Procedural 3D racing engine

Australian thoroughbred racing, simulated end to end — real tracks with their real shapes, the going scale from Firm 1 to Heavy 10, barrier draws, weights, sectionals and a race called as it happens.

Fan project, not affiliated with any racing authority. Tracks and race names are referenced editorially; horses, riders, trainers and owners are invented. Track dimensions follow published club figures and shift with rail placement.
